scenes.text: Learn to identify the unknown in a problem, represent the problem with an equation, and solve the problem concretely, pictorially or symbolically and represent and solve a given addition or subtraction problem involving a “part- part-whole” or comparison context, using a symbol to represent the unknown
30 pencils are in two boxes. One box has 8. Solve n plus 8 equals 30. The answer is 22. Subtract the known part from the whole.
Two friends have 33 balls altogether. One has 6. Write the missing amount. Pause and solve it in your exercise book.
